text:
Luis: PR #3598 is up - migration notes for routing policies and a small example rewrite for batching. Need reviews from @Rhea and @Sam. Target merge in tomorrow's docs window (13:00 PT). Main asks: enforce style guide (no first-person, use 'inference runtime'), ensure code fence conventions, and verify Go + TS snippets both produce the same example output. Also fixed a few dead anchors.

DocsBot: preview created 4dd https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/3598 - status: failing (1 lint: sentence-case headers, 1 preview diff: example output mismatch).

Rhea: taking a pass. Which headers need sentence case?

Luis: All top-level section headings were Title Case; change to sentence case. Also prefer imperative verbs in CLI examples. Example: change "How to Migrate" -> "How to migrate".

Sam: I'll check the snippet parity. Side note: snippets should use short deterministic outputs. For example use:

```python
client.create("gpt-small", prompt="hello")
# -> {"id":"resp_abc","text":"Hello"}
```

and in Go:

```go
resp, _ := client.Create("gpt-small", "hello")
// -> {"id":"resp_abc","text":"Hello"}
```

Make sure both have the same keys. The preview diff flagged the Go snippet returning additional debug metadata.

Tara: On voice: prefer "Redwood recommends" over "we recommend" and avoid casual exclamations like "Awesome!" in docs. Also, the lexicon says use "isolated deployment" not just "private" in explanatory text.

Luis: Good catch. I also updated the migration checklist at the top per feedback. Added bullets: 1) pin previous model version for rollback, 2) monitor kV cache invalidation, 3) validate routing rules in staging, 4) re-run evaluation suite, 5) confirm key management config. Keep each bullet under 12 words.

Rhea: Found a styling nit: code block language markers should be lowercase (```go not ```Go). Pushed tiny commit rhea/docs-3598-style.

DocsBot: preview updated - https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/3598 - status: failing (example output mismatch only).

Sam: Pushed fix - removed debug metadata from Go snippet and used the same deterministic mock response. Also trimmed multi-line outputs to one-liners. PTAL.

Luis: Please also ensure links to the capacity table are absolute (/docs/deployments#capacity-comparison) to avoid preview errors.

Rhea: Approved after header and voice fixes. :white_check_mark:

Tara: Approved. Confirmed TS + Go parity and sentence-case headers. :rocket:

DocsBot: preview is green 44c https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/3598

Luis: Merging in 13:00 PT slot as planned. Thanks all for quick turnaround. :tada:

DocsBot: PR #3598 merged by Luis at 2040123580.
